t.zh: 照片中的一个亮点会影响周围多个位置。二维处理能否由横向和纵向两次处理组成？结合已验证的方向约定与行列读取方式，用<wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>追踪一个输入对各输出的贡献，再组合已有元件。
t.en: A bright point in a photograph can influence several nearby positions. Can a two-dimensional operation be composed from horizontal and vertical passes? Using the established orientation and row and column addressing conventions, trace one input’s contributions with <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>, then combine the existing parts.

desc.zh: 输入图像与按书写顺序给出的行、列<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>，输出先横后竖的二维<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>，按<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>约定在图外取零。
desc.en: Given an image and written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pairs for rows and columns, computes 2D <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> across then down, using zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>中，横向与纵向的权重共同决定二维邻域中各位置的贡献。只有满足可分解条件的<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>才能这样处理，并非任意二维核都适用。
after.en: In a <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>, horizontal and vertical weights jointly determine each position’s contribution to the two-dimensional neighbourhood. This applies only to separable <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>, not every two-dimensional kernel.

brief.zh: 行权重 [1,2,1]、列权重 [1,0,−1]。追踪每个行权重经由列处理的贡献，写出组合后的 3×3 权重表。
brief.en: Row weights [1,2,1], column weights [1,0,−1]. Track each horizontal contribution through the column pass and fill the combined 3×3 weights.

hint.zh: 先跟踪中心行：列权重是 0 时，已有的横向结果还贡献多少？再比较上、下两行。
hint.en: Track the centre row first: what survives a column weight of 0? Then compare the upper and lower rows.

why.zh: 这是三行都抄了行权重：竖直方向也要乘上列权重，第 1 行整行乘 2。
why.en: That copies the row weights into all three rows: the column weights multiply too, doubling row 1.

brief.zh: 输入一张图、按书写顺序给出的行、列<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>（h1、h2、h3 与 v1、v2、v3）。输出二维<wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref>的结果，采用零<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>；两组输入不是窗口位置权重。
brief.en: Given an image and written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pairs for rows (h1,h2,h3) and columns (v1,v2,v3), output the 2D <wiki-ref to="mathematical-convolution"></wiki-ref> using zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>. These inputs are not positional window weights.

hint.zh: 回看<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>的方向实验。行、列部件都直接按位置乘权重，怎样让它们服从题目给出的书写<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>？
hint.en: Revisit the orientation experiment in <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>. Both row and column parts multiply positional weights directly; how can they implement the written <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref> pair?
